description: Fragment demonstrating how to start a browser session with a specific managed profile and optional native chrome profile directory. Ops are fully qualified so the fragment can be included from generic pipelines (core:include).
_migration_note: v2.1: qualified ops (browser:* / system:*) — bare 'goto' resolves to system:goto and fails under the generic engine. v2: Typed Flow format (role/produces/consumes). v1 used type without roles.
